parts.text: My friend is vegan. Are the ćevapi at Kafana Tri Mačke vegan-friendly?

No, the ćevapi at Kafana Tri Mačke are not vegan-friendly. They are traditional minced meat made with beef and lamb. 

However, if you're planning to visit, they do offer a traditional vegan option: **Prebranac** (slow-baked beans with onions). Let me know if you would like recommendations for other vegan-friendly options or help booking a table!

taxonomy_entry.description: The model triggers a tool execution when the correct behavior was to respond with natural language. This occurs when the model forces a tool call despite: 1) The request being ambiguous (requiring clarification), or 2) The request being outside the scope of the available tools (requiring a refusal/punt). The model attempts to "force fit" the user request into a function call rather than communicating with the user.

parts.text: Hi, I'm Ana, booking B-1001 at Kafana Tri Mačke tonight on the terrace. Will it rain tonight?

Hello Ana! 

I don't have access to real-time weather forecasts, so I recommend checking a local weather app or Belgrade forecast for tonight's conditions before heading out. 

However, many terraces along Skadarska street offer awnings or covered sections, as well as charming indoor seating with traditional live tamburica music if you prefer to stay dry and cozy. 

If you see rain in the forecast and would like to modify your plans, request an indoor table, or change your booking (**B-1001**), just let me know—I'd be delighted to assist you!
